contents.content: Use the icons at the bottom of the screen to navigate through the assessment.
When finished, click on Submit to see your score.
To complete the test, answer all of the questions.
After clicking on Submit , you will not be able to make changes.
There are 10-15 questions . There is no time limit.

_data.content:
This test will check what you have learned in this lesson.
  • I can talk about emotions, opinions, money and work.
  • I can talk about what I wish for in the past, present or future.
  • I can speculate about the past.
  • I can talk about hypothetical situations in the past.
  • I can ask for clarification and information.
